decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter extends the firm's core track system, so its lighting know-how lets it read the results and refine the product, and accessories like this stay in the range for years.

This LED luminaire sits close to the firm's core expertise, so it is easy to assimilate and improve, though individual luminaires in a broad premium range are often replaced by successor models after about four years.

The home automation server box builds on the firm's stated home automation offer and planning know-how, so the firm can learn from it, although fast-moving electronics carry some risk of the product being superseded.
A luminaire family with its own page is central to the established offer and benefits from the firm's design and engineering knowledge, which favours keeping and updating it rather than dropping it.
